==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
This dream is essentially a boss fight. It takes place inside of a school. There are a series of classrooms each containing a different section of the fight.

The first set of rooms all follow the same pattern. You have to either defeat all the robot zombies within the room or locate a floating item. Each floating item acts as a power-up.

In the final room you get access to almost all of the power-ups. There you have to fight a liquid metal shapeshifter. I was able to coach a friend to get them to the last level.
